attributes.title: 61st Annual AKPhA Convention & Tradeshow
attributes.summary:
The Alaska Pharmacy Association's 61st Annual Convention & Tradeshow runs Friday to Sunday, February 19 to 21, 2027, at the Hotel Captain Cook in downtown Anchorage. Over three days, pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, student pharmacists and industry representatives from across Alaska meet for accredited CE sessions, a tradeshow, committee work and networking.

Registration opens in winter 2026. The CE hours, full CE schedule and fees have not been published yet; AKPhA says the digital program with the CE schedule will be available through the registration portal. A discounted room block is available at the Hotel Captain Cook.
